description: Every single-valued relation \(G\subseteq\mathbb N^n\times\mathbb N\) is the graph of a partial function.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.graph_representation {n : ℕ}
  (G : Set (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.Args n × ℕ))
  (hG :
    ∀ (x : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.Args n) (a b : ℕ),
      (x, a) ∈ G → (x, b) ∈ G → a = b) :
  ∃ f, Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.graph f = G
